verified.reported_as: Extrap Energy = -12.762823 +/- 2.e-6 (first uploaded as -12.7628238567016 +/- 2.3e-6, commit c3fe8ad, rounded the same day)
verified.note: Transcribed correctly from the uploader's method string; bound_type extrapolated is right. Answer to the M6 flag: the sigma is the uploader's +/- on the extrapolation, not a statistical error; neither run script contains extrapolation code (they print E and var after the last sweep), and neither the extrapolation variable nor the meaning of +/- is stated anywhere (the VarBench paper, arXiv:2302.04919v2 S3.B.1, says only 'protocols for extrapolating the truncation error to zero can give greatly improved energy estimates and approximate errors on those estimates' and that VarBench itself 'forgo[es] extrapolations'). method_detail 'truncation error -> 0' is therefore an inference. Against the exact energy the value is within its +/-.
